transit.description: Hash-only node: re-runs check and test when a dependency's sources change.

build.description: The web bundle (the Go binaries are the root task go:build).

check.description: tsc (Go is type-checked by go:lint and go:test).

lint.description: Per-package lint. Go static checks are the root task go:lint, Biome the root task biome:check.

gen.description: TS client types from packages/api-client/openapi.json. That spec and charts/kuben/crds/kuben.dev_all.yaml are frozen contracts: Rust generated them up to 1.2, nothing regenerates them now, and the Go tests pin the server and the embedded CRDs to them.

size.description: Size budgets: web bundle (size-limit) and the hub binary.

//#biome:check.description: Biome lint and format check over the whole repository.

//#biome:fix.description: Biome format, organize imports and safe fixes.

//#go:build.description: The hub (bin/kuben) with the console embedded, and the agent (bin/kuben-agent): scripts/go-build.sh.

//#go:lint.description: Go static checks (scripts/go-check.sh: gofumpt, vet, exhaustive, go-check-sumtype, NilAway).

//#go:test.description: go test with the race detector, over the whole module.

//#go:dev.description: The API with every role, in dev mode (Vite proxies /api to it).

//#go:size.description: Binary size budget on the hub as it ships (static, console embedded).

//#go:e2e.description: End-to-end suite against the current kube context (e.g. kind).

test.description: bun test (go test is the root task go:test).

format.description: Per-package formatting (gofumpt is the root task go:format, Biome biome:fix).
